# Set Apart Movement

> Set Apart Movement is a student-led faith community built around faith, community, leadership, service, and real impact. It gathers students (ages 12–21, depending on the event) for hands-on mission challenges, authentic friendship, and spiritual growth.

## About

- Name: Set Apart Movement (also referred to as SAM)
- Founding location: Denton, Texas
- Area served: Texas (Dallas–Fort Worth metro area), including Denton, Hurst, Grapevine, and Flower Mound
- Audience: Students ages 12–21
- Contact: Text 817-983-3004 for more information and updates
- Community: WhatsApp group for staying connected between meetups

## What It Does

Set Apart Movement hosts free, RSVP-required meetups for students centered on a rotating mission theme — combining faith, community-building, leadership development, and hands-on service/mission challenges. Meetups are held at public locations across the DFW area (such as North East Mall in Hurst, TX, and parks in Denton, Grapevine, and Flower Mound, TX).
